turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have pain—it's a 5 out of 10. It’s in the side of my chest (right and left), upper chest/breast area (right), and also epigastric. The pain feels tedious, heavy, and exhausting, and it radiates to under the jaw, trachea, triceps (right), and shoulder (right). It gets worse with physical exertion and is alleviated with rest.
